description: Enphase persona-specific Figma email prompt rules (SFMC).
rules: Enphase persona requirement: build the email starting from the exact boilerplate of the approved Enphase main reference (references/Enphase_Main_Reference.html): its doctype, html namespaces, MSO conditional blocks, meta tags, complete CSS reset and email-client fixes, responsive utility class library, breakpoints, and outer wrapper/main-table structure. Set the document title and main-table width from the Figma metadata. The sample content blocks inside the reference remain forbidden as content sources.
Enphase persona requirement: every anchor must include conversion, data-linkto, href, title, and alias; web links also require target="_blank".
Enphase static web URLs must append utm_campaign=%%=v(@utm_campaign)=%% using ? when no query exists and & when a query already exists; never duplicate utm_campaign.
Enphase mailto and sms links use conversion="false" and data-linkto="other" and must not receive campaign UTM parameters.

If any phone number appears in an Enphase email, declare @CallCTA before HTML (topmost) using the exact signature SET @CallCTA = CloudPagesURL(2683, "phone", URLEncode("<phone-number>"), "utm_campaign", v(@utm_campaign)) and use href="%%=RedirectTo(@CallCTA)=%%" on phone-number anchors with conversion="true" and data-linkto="https://".
Enphase anchors with no provided destination URL use href="#" and still append the utm_campaign parameter.

Enphase header/footer country selection: use references/Header and Footer Blocks.md as the source of truth. Detect the target country/language from user instructions or content, then insert the matching header and its corresponding footer as a pair, updating both the %%=ContentBlockbyID("ID")=%% value and the paired comment names to the exact block names used. If no matching block exists (or a country has a header but no footer, e.g. Greece/Malta), fall back to the US pair: Header_Dark_Version1_EN (196561) and NA_Footer_Section (171497). Never mix different countries' header and footer outside this fallback. Set @utm_campaign per user instructions; keep the 'UTM_Here' placeholder only when no campaign value is given.
